# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please **do not** report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues.

Instead, please report them using GitHub's **Private Vulnerability Reporting**:

1. Navigate to the **Security** tab of this repository.
2. Click **Advisories** on the left sidebar.
3. Click the **Report a vulnerability** button.

We appreciate your efforts to responsibly disclose your findings and will do our best to acknowledge receipt and address the issue promptly.
